comment: Curated HTTP application fingerprints: web apps that sit behind a generic web server, whose identity is in HTTP evidence rather than Nmap's service product. 'evidence' selects the source: 'server' (Server header or Nmap's http service product), 'generator' (the <meta name=generator> content, e.g. Nmap's http-generator), 'header' (a named response header, lower-case in 'header'), 'x_powered_by' (the X-Powered-By header), 'title' (the page title). 'pattern' is an RE2 regex, anchored by the author; 'version_group' is the submatch holding the version (0 = none, giving a LOW, versionless identity). Vendors/products checked against NVD. version groups capture the product version only, never a framework/connector version.

apps.note: AJP/HTTP connector banner; identifies Tomcat but not its version.
Drupal dynamic-cache header; present without a version.
